official_measurement_examples: England recognises 56 habitats of principal importance under Section 41
the national Priority Habitat Inventory maps 27 principal terrestrial and freshwater/coastal habitat types rather than all 56
priority habitat can occur inside or outside SSSIs
local wildlife sites are locally protected sites distinct from SSSIs and Local Nature Reserves
NPPF requires plans to identify map and safeguard local wildlife-rich habitats and ecological networks
priority-habitat inventory is a starting spatial evidence layer rather than a site survey
absence from a mapped inventory does not prove absence of priority habitat or protected species
priority-habitat or local-site status does not establish ownership planning permission or final development yield
core_rules: priority habitat is not Local Wildlife Site
Local Wildlife Site is not Local Nature Reserve
inventory presence is not automatic planning refusal
inventory absence is not habitat absence proof
national inventory is not parcel ecological survey
Section41 habitat status is distinct from protected-species law
local designation status must retain local authority/date context
BNG metric is distinct from priority-habitat designation
habitat significance must be assessed proposal-specifically
priority-habitat map is not cadastral title geometry
habitat status does not establish ownership
habitat status does not prove development capacity
mitigation hierarchy is not permission grant
no parcel biodiversity clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Official Defra, Natural England, GOV.UK, Environment Data and legislation sources checked 2026-07-26. February/July 2026 biodiversity updates retained with priority-habitat/local-site/SSSI/inventory separation; no parcel promotion.
